items.title: Nintendo Switch
items.line: It launched March 3 at $299.99, a console you could lift out of the dock and carry. Nintendo expected to ship two million in the first month.

items.title: Get Out
items.line: Jordan Peele's debut opened wide on February 24 on a $4.5 million budget and made over $255 million. The sunken place became everyone's shorthand.

items.title: Despacito
items.line: Released January 13, it spent 16 straight weeks at number one on the Hot 100 from May. Its video was the first on YouTube to reach 3 billion views, on August 4.

items.title: Fidget spinners
items.line: They took over 2017, sold at Amazon, 7-Eleven and Toys R Us, and a lot of school districts banned them from classrooms.

items.title: The 2017 total solar eclipse
items.line: On August 21 totality crossed 14 US states from Oregon to South Carolina. The longest stretch was 2 minutes 41.6 seconds, near Carbondale, Illinois.

items.title: Lofi hip hop radio
items.line: ChilledCow started its nonstop 'beats to relax/study to' stream on February 25. It was pulled that summer over anime footage and came back in September with new animation.
